summary: BCE Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-11-05 carrying its third-quarter 2026 shareholder report: MD&A (Exhibit 99.1), unaudited interim financial statements (99.2), CEO/CFO certifications (99.3), a news release (99.4), Bell Canada selected financial information (99.5) and an earnings-coverage exhibit (99.6), for the period ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, offer, stake, price per share, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly reporting package incorporated by reference into existing Canadian and US shelf registrations. No special-situation event; no risk-arb angle.
